items.name: Boscolo Lyon Hotel & Spa
items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Boscolo Lyon Hotel & SpaBoscolo Lyon Hotel & Spa is a hotel set in a historic building on the Presqu'île of Lyon, on the banks of the Rhône river, 850 metres from Lyon National Opera House. The hotel has a bar and a 24-hour reception.

At the hotel, all rooms measure at least 30 metres² and feature luxurious decorations. Rooms come complete with a private bathroom equipped with a walk-in shower, bidet and free toiletries, while certain units at Boscolo Lyon Hotel & Spa also offer a seating area. Certain rooms offer a river view.

The daily breakfast offers continental and buffet options. Guests can enjoy a meal at the in-house restaurant, which serves Italian cuisine.

Boscolo Lyon Hotel & Spa offers spa and fitness center.

Place Bellecour is 500 metres away and the Old Town of Lyon is less than 1 km away. The nearest airport, Lyon - Saint Exupery Airport, is 30 km from the hotel and is accessible from the property via the A metro line and then the Rhonexpress.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Set in Lyon’s 2nd arrondissement, 450 metres from Lyon-Perrache Train Station and 600 metres from Perrache Metro Station,  Aparthotel Adagio Lyon Patio Confluence offers accommodation with free access to the fitness centre. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

All studios feature a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a safety deposit box and a wardrobe. The private bathroom offers a hairdryer and a heated towel rail. The kitchenette is equipped with a microwave, refrigerator and electric kettle.

A cold sweet and savoury buffet breakfast is available daily at an additional cost and includes breads, eggs, fruit salad, fresh fruits, cottage cheese, cold cuts, cheeses, hot drinks and yogurts. Guests may have breakfast delivered to their room. The property also has a laundry room with a washing machine, a tumble dryer and ironing facilities.

Sainte-Blandine Tram Stop can be found a 2-minute walk from the property, while Vieux Lyon is a 6-minute drive away. Confluence shopping centre is an 8-minute walk from  Aparthotel Adagio Lyon Patio Confluence while Place Bellecour and Confluences Museum are a 20-minute walk away. hostInfo.name: Adagio Aparthotel
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: The Adagio Lyon Patio Confluence aparthotel welcomes you for business trips and family getaways. Ideally located in the vibrant Confluence district, you will be in the heart of the City of Lights, close to the Musée des Confluences and the banks of the Saône. This residence is housed in a beautiful stone building with high ceilings, giving it a stylish and distinctly modern character. It offers 103 apartments distributed as follows: 83 studios for 2 people, 9 duplexes for 2 people, and 11 studios for 3 people, including 3 studios for persons with reduced mobility (PRM). In addition, a seminar room with 40 seats is available for your business meetings. Moreover, our aparthotel combines comfort and modernity and is fully equipped. To make you feel at home, you benefit from a fully equipped kitchen, a separate bedroom, and a workspace. You will also have access to various hotel services to make your stay enjoyable: a paid private parking, a fitness room, and a laundry area.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: Combining the flexibility of an apartment with the services of a hotel, Adagio aparthotels are the best solution for medium and long stays, offering the utmost comfort and value for money to business travelers, vacationers and those who like to be both.

About this propertyModern Comforts: Bikube Coliving Hôtel in Lyon offers a recently renovated 4-star hotel with a fitness centre, sun terrace, garden, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi. Guests enjoy a lounge, fitness room, lift, 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and evening entertainment.

Dining Experience: The hotel serves a continental, buffet, vegetarian, and gluten-free breakfast with juice, fresh pastries, cheese, and fruits. Dining options include brunch, lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails, featuring Greek, Italian, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, pizza, and Spanish cuisines.

Prime Location: Located 1.8 km from Part-Dieu Train Station and a 9-minute walk to Institut & Musée Lumière, the hotel is near attractions such as Musée Miniature et Cinéma (3.4 km) and Lyon National Opera (3.8 km). You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Villa Maïa. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Villa MaïaLocated on Fourvière Hill in Lyon and offering panoramic views over the city, Villa Maïa features an indoor heated swimming pool, a hot tub, a steam room and a fitness room. The indoor pool offers views of the garden which was designed by the landscaper Louis Benech. Free WiFi is provided throughout the property and valet parking is available on site. The property is a 10-minute walk from the old town and a 5-minute walk from The Ancient Theatre of Fourvière.

All rooms, suites and apartments are fitted with a flat-screen satellite TV. A courtesy minibar is offered in each room. Certain rooms include a seating area to relax in after a busy day. Every room is equipped with a private bathroom, entirely made of Carrara marble, where you will find bathrobes, slippers and free toiletries. The toiletries were created especially for Villa Maïa with the scent of garden flowers.

A buffet or continental breakfast is offered every morning and includes organic jam, eggs from local farms, crepes, waffles, pancakes and French toast. Gluten-free products are available. The continental breakfast can also be served in the guest rooms. Room service is available 24/7 and you will find a 24-hour front desk and a concierge service at the property. Guests can enjoy a drink at the on-site bar. The property is in partnership with the 1-star Michelin Têtedoie restaurant, located a 1-minute walk away, and guests can reserve a table directly at Villa Maïa.

The Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourviere is 400 metres from Villa Maïa, while Place des Terreaux is 1.2 km away. The nearest airport is Lyon - Saint Exupery Airport, 20 km from the property. A charging station for electric cars is available at this property.

Villa Maïa has a partnership with the 1 star restaurant Michelin Têtedoie, which is 1 minute walk away, and can book a table for you.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Villa Florentine, A Beauvallon Hotel & SpaVilla Florentine, A Beauvallon Hotel & Spa is located in the heart of Old Lyon with panoramic views of the city. This former convent offers elegant guest rooms, a 24-hour reception and free WiFi throughout.

Each air-conditioned guest room at Villa Florentine, A Beauvallon Hotel & Spa has an elegant decor and is equipped with a flat-screen TV with Canal + and beIn Sports channels and a minibar and some rooms have a seating area. Guests can have breakfast prepared with fresh and local produce in Villa Florentine, A Beauvallon Hotel & Spa’s breakfast room or in their room, on the terrace with views of the city or in the bar upon request.

Les Terrasses de Lyon, Villa Florentine, A Beauvallon Hotel & Spa's gastronomic restaurant, features an outdoor terrace and serves traditional French cuisine and regional specialties.

Additional facilities available include a fitness centre with sauna, steam room, a cardio training room and a small beauty treatment area. Guests also have access to a heated swimming pool.

For guests with cars, private parking is possible on site for a supplement. The hotel is located 4.5 km from Lyon Part-Dieu Train Station. hostInfo.name: Groupe Smartlodge - Appart-hôtel Q7 Lodge - Lyon 7
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Ideally located in Lyon’s 7th arrondissement, in a quiet residential area, Appart hôtel Q7 Lodge Lyon 7 offers 97 spacious, bright, and fully equipped studios accommodating from 1 to 4 guests. Ideal for leisure stays, business trips, and family getaways, the property enjoys a strategic location close to Place Jean Jaurès Metro Station, the Gerland and Confluence districts, and the A7 motorway.
All studios feature an equipped kitchenette, flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free high-speed fiber WiFi, a workspace, and a safe. A cooling system is available during summer and heating in winter. Soundproof walls also ensure a comfortable and peaceful stay.
A 24-hour reception, free fitness room, terrace, and private parking (at an additional cost) complete the property’s services. Halle Tony Garnier concert hall, the Confluence Museum, Place Bellecour, Vieux Lyon, and the Westfield La Part-Dieu shopping centre can all be reached quickly by car or public transport.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Smartlodge is an independent French hotel group offering ideally located 3- and 4-star hotels and aparthotels across France, notably in Lyon 7, Courbevoie–La Défense, and Paris 13. 
Founded in Lyon in 2016 by hospitality enthusiasts, the group provides a modern, comfortable, and accessible stay experience tailored to business travelers, families, and leisure guests alike. Each property combines a strategic location, quality services, and a welcoming atmosphere to meet the needs of every traveler.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Located in Lyon’s dynamic 7th arrondissement, our property enjoys a strategic location close to the ring road and the A7 motorway, making it ideal for both business travelers and guests arriving by car.
This fast-growing district combines urban life, universities, and major business hubs. Guests can easily reach the Gerland and Confluence districts, as well as the banks of the Rhône River, perfect for walking, dining, and discovering Lyon.
Jean Jaurès Metro Station (Line B) is less than a 5-minute walk away, providing quick access to Lyon city center, Part-Dieu train station, and the city’s main attractions. Restaurants, cafés, shops, and local services nearby also make the stay convenient and enjoyable for both families and business travelers.
hostInfo.familyTips:
Our studios are especially appreciated by families looking for a comfortable and independent stay. Thanks to the fully equipped kitchenette, guests can prepare their own meals on-site, a real advantage for family stays, especially with young children.
Our “Grand Studio avec Canapé-Lit” category offers generous living spaces designed for families, comfortably accommodating up to 4 guests. A baby cot is also available on request and subject to availability.
Perfect for family weekend stays, our studios allow guests to enjoy the city while benefiting from the comfort and flexibility of practical and welcoming accommodation.

items.name: Crowne Plaza Lyon - Cité Internationale
items.description:
Welcome to the Crowne Plaza Lyon Hotel, where conviviality and comfort come together to offer you an unforgettable experience. Located in the heart of the 6th district, within the Cité Internationale, this establishment is the ideal place to relax and enjoy all the wonders of Lyon, 10 minutes from the city centre and the Part-Dieu train station. Public transport and bicycles can be rented in front of the hotel, while car and bicycle parking is at the foot of the property (fees apply).
When you enter, you are immediately greeted by a warm and modern decor. Whether you are here for business or pleasure,the Crowne Plaza Lyon hotel is the ideal place for you, the caring and dedicated team is here to meet all your needs.
The spacious and bright rooms offer you all the necessary comforts: safe, ironing board, selection of coffee and tea, as well as free Wifi and access to a Chromecast service. Personalize your stay and treat yourself to a room with a shower, bath or balcony. A preference for a high floor? it is also possible! Finally, connecting family rooms and suites will be an undeniable asset for the organization of your family trip or weekend.
The hotel is also known for the quality of its bedding, a good night’s sleep awaits you.
The restaurant - bar offers a friendly experience with its superb room, its central bar and its large terrace facing the park. Throughout the day, the Chef prepares a varied menu with Italian flavours: dishes to share, daily menu... you will be delighted! Enjoy a refreshing cocktail and antipasti and enjoy a relaxing moment.
If you are looking for something to do after a busy day, you can choose between a fitness centre, a walk along the Rhone River or a race in the park with its entrance facing the hotel.

Citadines Part-Dieu Lyon is a residence located 150 metres from the Part-Dieu shopping centre. It is a 10-minute walk from the Part-Dieu TGV Train Station and offers apartments and studios with equipped kitchenettes. Free WiFi is available throughout.

The apart'hotel Citadines Part-Dieu Lyon is located in the city center, a few minutes walk from La Part-Dieu shopping center and at 900 metres from Lyon Part Dieu train station. Bellecour Place and Tete d'Or Park are located within 20 minutes walk and the Historical Center: the Vieux Lyon at 25-minutes. 

All studios and apartments are equipped with complimentary highspeed WiFi, a flat-screen TV, a safe box,  and an electric kettle. The kitchen is separated and supplied with hobs, a microwave, a refrigerator and a dishwasher. All bathrooms have a bathtub.

The serviced apartment offers free hot beverages in the lobby, and a breakfast room. Reception is available from 7am to 10pm. Optional services: on-site launderette, dry-cleaning services, extra cleaning. Private parking upon availability, charges will apply.

Precisely renovated in 2023, the Academy offers travelers who stay there a unique hotel experience at the heart of the History of Knowledge.

Located in the historic district of Old Lyon, a UNESCO World Heritage site, L'Académie offers an ideal location allowing travelers to enjoy direct access to all the tourist activities available to the City of Lyon (museums, monuments, best restaurants and stops…)

Designed in a building dating from 1406, this luxury hotel offers 12 rooms and suites in a neat decor inspired by the world of French Academicians who shaped the knowledge of our world.
French ceilings, woodwork, solid parquet floors and high-end materials tastefully decorate the rooms and suites of this exceptional establishment. The latter, depending on the category, offer a view of the emblematic cobbled streets of Old Lyon or of a private courtyard. All rooms and suites have private bathrooms. They are air-conditioned, soundproofed and equipped with a TV and free Wi-Fi access. A continental breakfast is served daily for an extra charge.

The Academy is also committed to more responsible tourism and is implementing various actions to protect the environment, reduce waste and energy consumption.

It has a French window as the main opening and is accessible to people with reduced mobility.

Just 100 metres from Sans Souci Metro stop, this Mercure hotel is a 10-minute Metro ride from Lyon’s city centre and the Part-Dieu Train Station. It offers stylish rooms with a cinema theme.

Each air-conditioned room at the Mercure Lyon Lumière is equipped with free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom. All rooms are accessible by a lift.

A buffet and an express breakfast are served daily at the Lumière, and the Le Hangar style restaurant serves traditional and regional cuisine. Guests can enjoy a drink at the hotel’s bar.

The Lumiere provides an underground private car park and it is 5 minutes from the Musée Lulière and the Manufacture des Tabacs. The property is also a 7-minute walk from Line 3 Dauphiné Lacassagne Tram Stop, with a connection to the Part Dieu Train Station. The air-conditioned guest rooms are each equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and tea and coffee making facilities. All rooms are serviced by a lift and feature a private bathroom with a bath or shower and hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast with fresh local produce is served each morning in Lyon Centre Brotteaux’s breakfast room or in guests’ rooms upon request.

Additional facilities available at the hotel include a 24-hour reception, free newspapers and luggage storage.

La Cité Internationale and the cinema are a 7-minute drive from the hotel. Lyon's Old Town is 2.6 km away. items.description:
Hôtel du Simplon offers en suite accommodation in Lyon’s Presqu'île district between the Rhone and Saône Rivers. Each room is uniquely decorated and free WiFi is available throughout the hotel.

Hôtel du Simplon rooms are equipped with air conditioning, a satellite TV and a private bathroom with a bath or shower. Rooms are accessible by lift. A baby cot is available free of charge, upon request and availability.

Guests are invited to relax in du Simplon’s drawing room, which still has its original mosaic floor and a Weimar piano. The front desk is open 24 hours a day, for guests’ convenience. Simplon Hotel’s staff is available to recommend nearby restaurants.

Several services are available on site for cyclists, including bicycle storage in the closed courtyard for up to 4 bicycles.

Hotel du Simplon is conveniently located between Place Bellecour and the Lyon-Perrache railway station. It is just 450 metres from the Ampère Victor Hugo Metro (line A), making it easy to explore Lyon.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.1 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
